Class AABB

java.lang.Object
net.murat.math.AABB
public class AABB extends Object
Axis-aligned bounding box used for fast ray rejection and BVH acceleration.

    • reset

      public AABB reset()
      PERFORMANCE METHOD: Resets this AABB to an empty/initial state. Sets min values to +Infinity and max values to -Infinity. Used for garbage-free reuse of AABB instances.

      public boolean intersect(Ray ray)
      Ray-box intersection test without a distance cutoff. Kept for backward compatibility; delegates to the tMax-aware overload.

    • intersect

      public boolean intersect(Ray ray, double tMax)
      Ray-box intersection test with a distance cutoff (tMax). BVH traversal must use this overload: it allows a node to be rejected not only when the ray misses the box outright, but also when the box is entirely farther away than the closest hit already found. Without this cutoff, BVH traversal degenerates into visiting every node whose box the ray happens to cross, regardless of whether a closer hit already makes that node irrelevant.
